purpose: Teach: 公用/専売/敬称/埋め立て/買い取り/廉価/覚書/即日

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、公用書類を自ら整えられたぞ
lines.en: Your father — he prepared the founding documents himself, you know.
lines.style: Gentle remembrance. Quiet authority. Pauses between clauses like he's placing each memory carefully. Warm and unrushed, the voice of someone recalling something he respects.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは専売契約を結ぶ目利きをお持ちでした
lines.en: Yes. Father had a real gift for reading people in business — knowing who to contract with.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Nods with the words. Not defensive — affirming. The tone of a son honoring what his father saw that he might not have fully grasped at first.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員にも敬称を欠かさなかったぞ
lines.en: Your father never neglected courtesy with the staff, not once.
lines.style: Wistful certainty. Slower pace. The slight catch of someone saying something that mattered and wishes had been said more often. Trailing softness at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは埋め立て事業への参入も決断されました
lines.en: Yes. Father made the decision to enter the land reclamation business — a bold move.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Grounded delivery. Acknowledging scale without inflation. The tone of someone turning over a choice in his hands, understanding its weight now.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、競合の買い取り交渉を成功させたぞ
lines.en: Your father brought off the negotiations to acquire a rival firm — and he did it cleanly.
lines.style: Admiring understatement. Each word deliberate. A pause before 'cleanly' like he's saying something that shouldn't need saying but does. The pride of a man recalling something difficult done well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは廉価ラインも品質を保たれた
lines.en: Yes. Father kept quality even in the budget line — that wasn't negotiable for him.
lines.style: Steady, certain. No doubt in the voice. A small firmness on 'wasn't negotiable' — not harsh, just clear conviction. Speaking from something he inherited and understands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お取引先との覚書を大切にされたぞ
lines.en: Your father held every agreement with partners sacred — every one.
lines.style: Measured, reverent. Slight emphasis on 'sacred' like he's using the right word for what it meant. Unhurried. The voice of someone who came to understand this principle later than he should have.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは即日対応の文化を社内に作られた
lines.en: Yes. Father built a culture of answering on the same day — that was his standard.
lines.style: Affirmative, almost serene. A gentle close. Quiet confidence in every word. The voice of someone who has carried that lesson into his own life and knows its value. Slight fade at the very end.
